name: Anthropic & Claude
description: Claude models and apps, Claude Code, the Claude developer platform, partnerships, research and safety policy.

items.title: Anthropic adds ready-to-use legal artifacts to Claude for Legal
items.summary: Anthropic added a gallery of ready-to-use interactive artifacts for Claude for Legal, including tools for contract review, regulatory tracking, and routing legal requests. Legal teams can adapt and share the tools using their own data and connectors, extending Claude Enterprise’s workflow options for legal work.

items.title: Anthropic reports Claude-assisted vulnerability discoveries in widely used software
items.summary: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that an internal research model helped identify serious vulnerabilities across widely used software. Anthropic says the findings were reported to affected vendors, and that 62 Google-assigned CVEs had been patched as of Chrome 156; the report highlights the growing relevance of AI-assisted defensive security research.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.312 adds gateway identity-claim support and improvements
items.summary: Anthropic published Claude Code v2.1.312, adding an OIDC user-ID claim setting for the Claude apps gateway, including support for claims such as Microsoft Entra ID’s `oid`. The release also includes usability, settings, and reliability fixes across Claude Code, VS Code, and cloud sessions.

items.title: Anthropic expands Claude for Financial Advisors with partner connectors
items.summary: Anthropic updated Claude for Financial Advisors with additional partner integrations and workflow skills for advisors. One announced addition brings J.P. Morgan Asset Management subsidiary 55ip’s tax-aware portfolio technology into Claude through a new connector.

items.title: Anthropic shares early Claude-assisted drug-development progress
items.summary: Anthropic reported early results from Claude-related work with six life-sciences organizations: BigHat Biosciences, Bristol Myers Squibb, Divergence Labs, Enveda, Generate Biomedicines, and The Column Group. It also described in-house drug-discovery efforts, including programs focused on rare forms of muscular dystrophy, illustrating an expansion of Claude’s use into biomedical research.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude for Nonprofits plugin
items.summary: Anthropic released a Claude for Nonprofits plugin, built with about 30 nonprofit organizations, with skills and connectors for fundraising, marketing, hiring, and related operational work. It is included at no additional cost for nonprofits on Team and Enterprise plans; Anthropic also plans to extend its Claude Corps program through a Taproot partnership.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.311 adds self-hosted runner controls and reliability fixes
items.summary: Anthropic published Claude Code v2.1.311 with new `--hold-idle-file` and `--max-hold-min` controls for self-hosted runners, alongside fixes spanning startup freezes, context handling, MCP tools, and background sessions. The release also changes `ultrathink` to run at xhigh effort on specified Claude models through Anthropic’s API.

items.title: Claude Code contributor Thariq says he has left Anthropic
items.summary: Thariq publicly said he had left Anthropic after more than a year working on Claude Code. His post thanked colleagues and the Claude Code community; it is notable personnel news related to Claude Code, though it does not announce a product change.
